name: Unistreets
rootCause: arbitrary call injection via unvalidated launch forwarding. Lost: ~17,743.91 USDC + ~0.0072 WETH (~$17.75K)

descriptions.text: arbitrary call injection via unvalidated launch forwarding. Lost: ~17,743.91 USDC + ~0.0072 WETH (~$17.75K)

Unistreets LaunchpadFactoryAuto contract on Ethereum was exploited via arbitrary calldata injection. The factory custodied all launched tokens’ Uniswap V4 LP NFTs; the attacker injected setApprovalForAll approval and burned multiple LP positions, draining liquidity for a loss of approximately $17,750.

Unistreets' LaunchpadFactoryAuto contract was exploited on Ethereum on 5 August 2026, resulting in the loss of 17,743 USDC, a small amount of WETH, and launched memecoin LP assets. Attackers abused arbitrary calldata injection to gain operator rights over all factory-held Uniswap v4 LP positions and drain liquidity in two coordinated transactions. The LaunchpadFactoryAuto contract allowed user-supplied calldata blobs to be forwarded unchecked to PositionManager.multicall(), enabling attackers to inject setApprovalForAll calls that gave exploit contracts operator authority over every factory-owned liquidity position. This let them burn and drain these positions directly.
